lich.check:
* LICH - No. 159 - DEATH - 3 STARS.
* MAG 99, RES 173, ATK 25.
* It does not touch what it destroys. It has not left this wood in a long time.
lich.intro:
* The moss goes cold. A crimson robe drifts out between the trees.
* LICH blocks the way.
idle: * Lich hovers above the trail. The moss beneath it withers.
* Lich murmurs an incantation in a language older than Wesing.
* The smell of tallow and crumbling pages.
* The void beneath its hood turns toward the Waystone, then back to you.
* Lich speaks a few words very quietly, the way a man repeats a lesson he was made to learn.
talk:
The stone
has begun
to speak.

I can no
longer
refuse it.

Go home.
This is the
last time.
lich.spare_text:
* Lich lowers its staff.
* It drifts back into the Mosswood, its incantation falling silent.
* It does not watch you go. It watches the road behind you.
* Lich was spared.

acts.name: Bow
text: * You bow before Lich as one would before an elder.
* The void beneath its hood regards you for a long while.
* Its hostility wanes.

acts.name: Ask of the Books
text: * You ask Lich what was written in the books it kept.
* It begins to answer. The words come slowly, half-forgotten.
* Then it stops, as if it has read ahead to the last page.
* For a moment, it remembers itself.

acts.name: Resist Sleep
text: * The cold makes your eyes heavy. You force them open.
* Lich watches you fight it. It knows what Awaken is for.
* It seems to respect the effort. It seems, too, to be sorry for it.

noko.check:
* NOKO - No. 079 - FIRE - 3 STARS.
* ATK 8, MAG 8, SPD 19. Flame and Wiggle, both fire.
* The first form of Orochi. It should have grown into one long ago.
noko.intro:
* Noko is coiled around the foot of the great darkened Waystone.
* It rears up the stone's face. The rings on its tail glow like coals.
idle: * Noko sways against the Waystone. Its scales smoke where they touch the stone.
* Black veins pulse along its back, in time with the Waystone.
* Smoke and the smell of scorched scales hang in the air.
* The red rings on its tail flare, then dim, then flare again.
* A single deep furrow runs down the north road behind it, as if it was dragged here.
talk:
A hundred
years. I
have not
grown.

The grey
one spoke
my name.

Turn your
back. I
am owed.
noko.spare_text:
* Noko's hissing falls silent.
* It lowers itself to the ground and draws its coils back around the Waystone.
* The black veins along its back begin to fade. It does not look relieved.

acts.name: Kneel by the Stone
text: * You kneel at the foot of the Waystone, within reach of its jaws.
* Noko sways over you. It does not strike.
* The fire in its throat burns lower.

acts.name: Speak Softly
text: * You speak to it quietly, the way you would to a frightened animal.
* Its hissing thins. Nothing has spoken to it gently in a long time.
* Its tail stops lashing the ash.

acts.name: Say Its Name
text: * You say its name, softly: Noko.
* It goes still at once. Someone has said that name to it lately.
* Somewhere in those small coils, something remembers not burning.

orochi.check:
* OROCHI - No. 080 - FIRE - 8.5 STARS.
* The Overlord of Norwoods. An eight-headed serpent, evolved from Noko.
* Eight heads. Each one is in pain.
orochi.intro:
* Orochi rises out of the dark, coil over coil.
* One head turns toward you. Then all eight.
idle: * Orochi's heads hiss over one another. None of them sound like their own.
* Black veins pulse along its coils, in time with something far below.
* Smoke and the smell of scorched scales hang in the air.
* Embers drift up between the heads and die in the dark.
* Deep furrows run through the trees behind it, as if something very heavy was dragged there.
talk:
The grey
one spoke
our name.

Turn your
back. We
are owed.
orochi.spare_text:
* The heads fall silent, one by one.
* Orochi lowers itself to the ground and draws its coils back into the dark.
* The black veins along its scales begin to fade. It does not look relieved.

acts.name: Name the Heads
text: * You speak to each head in turn, slowly, one at a time.
* ...five, six, seven, eight.
* The hissing thins. Each head was waiting to be heard.

acts.name: Stand Unarmed
text: * You lower your hands and stand within reach of its jaws.
* Eight heads hover over you. None of them strike.
* The fire in its throats burns lower.

acts.name: Recall Noko
text: * You tell Orochi of Noko, the small serpent it once was.
* All eight heads go still at once. Someone has said that name to it lately.
* Somewhere in those coils, something remembers being small, and not burning.

divine.check:
* DIVINE - No. 202 - LIFE - 9 STARS.
* A Spirit of the Sanctuary. Immune to all negative status effects.
* It does not regard you as a foe.
divine.intro:
* Light pours down from above.
* Divine descends.
idle: * Divine hovers in perfect silence. Its wings do not move.
* The light around its head is steady and warm.
* The Waystone's shadow draws back from it.
* The air is still and clean, like the Sanctuary at dawn.
* Divine looks at you the way a lamplighter looks at a lamp that has been filled.
divine.spare_text:
* Divine lowers its wings.
* The Waystone drinks its light and burns again. Not as bright as it once did.

acts.name: Pray
text: * You fold your hands and pray.
* Divine's glow softens.

acts.name: Bow
text: * You bow low before the winged spirit.
* Divine inclines its head, as if marking something down.

acts.name: Show Mercy
text: * You tell Divine you spared the one at the Waystone.
* For a moment, the light feels warm instead of blinding.
* It is pleased with you. It is very pleased with you.

blood_rogue.check:
* BLOOD ROGUE - No. 149 - FIRE - 5.5 STARS.
* SPD 36, DEF 30. Its Slay cuts twice as deep into humanoid flesh.
* Its Vengeance grows heavier for every one of its own that has fallen.
blood_rogue.intro:
* The silence among the graves is complete.
* A hooded figure rises from the altar steps.
* Blood Rogue draws its blade. The rite will wait for you.
idle: * Blood Rogue stands between you and the altar. It does not move aside.
* Red light seeps from the seams of its coat, like a wound that will not close.
* Behind it, the ritual fire gutters. No one is left to feed it.
* Blood Rogue turns its hood toward the fallen. It seems to be counting them.
* On the hand it keeps on the altar, a ring of carved horn.
* Its head is bowed a little to one side, as if it is listening for someone very small.
talk:
Each one
that falls
feeds me.

I was a
priest once.
Like them.
blood_rogue.spare_text:
* Blood Rogue lowers its blade.
* It looks long at the priests lying in the ring.
* Then it puts out the ritual fire with its own hand, and walks into the dark between the stones.

acts.name: Spare Its Kin
text: * You turn your blade away from the fallen priests in the ring.
* You do not strike the ones who are down.
* Blood Rogue watches. Its grip on the blade loosens, slightly.

acts.name: Name the Dead
text: * You call down the steps the names you read on the stones below, aloud and slowly.
* Blood Rogue's hood lifts at each name.
* You name the stone with the hunting horn cut beside it. Blood Rogue stops counting.
* For a moment the red light in its coat dims.

acts.name: Stand Your Ground
text: * You plant your feet between Blood Rogue and the altar.
* You do not kneel.
* Blood Rogue tilts its hood. It has not been refused in a long time.

cult_rogue.check:
* CULT ROGUE - No. 089 - AIR - 4.5 STARS.
* It leads the wind priests. Its word strengthens and hastens its kin.
* Its blade strikes quickly, or slowly and very hard.
cult_rogue.intro: * The figure before the shrine rises from its knees. A hooded shape, blade lowered.
idle: * The Cult Rogue does not move. The wind moves around it.
* The violet sash stirs, though the air is still.
* Behind it, the feathers in the basin stir. There is no one left to chant.
* The curved blade tilts, catching what little light there is.
* Its hands are broad and calloused across the palms, the way a rower's are.
talk:
The wind
chose me
to lead.

Leave this
place to
the wind.

The river
is wide.
I stayed.
cult_rogue.spare_text:
* The Cult Rogue sheathes its blade. Without a word, the cult disperses into the wind.
* It goes last, and it does not look east.

acts.name: Hold Ground
text: * You plant your feet and do not give way.
* The Cult Rogue studies you. Its blade lowers a little.

acts.name: Name Dundean
text: * You tell it the people of Dundean fear the wind priests.
* The hood turns east, toward the roofs of Dundean. For a moment, it says nothing.

acts.name: Lower Weapon
text: * You lower your weapon and wait.
* The chant falters. The Cult Rogue raises a hand, and its priests fall silent.

apalala.check:
* APALALA - WATER - STARS UNRECORDED.
* A Dragon Overlord. Its true form is a Blue Wyrm.
* Attack Break leaves your arms heavy. Ocean Ruler strikes Water twice as hard.
apalala.intro:
* Water runs down the cliff where no stream should be.
* Something vast shifts on the pass above you.
* Apalala lowers its head into the road.
idle: * Apalala breathes slowly. Each breath sounds like surf on stone.
* Water beads on its scales and runs off into the dust.
* The red glow in the cliffs shows on its wings and nowhere else.
* It has not moved from the mouth of the pass.
* Its eyes keep going to your hands.
talk:
Turn back.
The pass
is closed.

I was
Apalala
of the river.

I keep
the pass.
I keep it.

Turn back,
or be taken
by the water.
apalala.spare_text:
* Apalala's breathing slows until you cannot hear it over the wind.
* It draws its wings in and moves aside from the road.
* The water stops running down the cliff.

acts.name: Kneel
text: * You kneel in the road below its head and stay there.
* Apalala watches you for a long time.
* Its breathing slows a little.

acts.name: Speak of Water
text: * You tell it about the rivers you crossed, and the lake at home.
* Its head tilts, the way a hatchling's does when it hears its name.
* For a moment it seems to be somewhere else.

acts.name: Show Empty Hands
text: * You open your hands. There is no ash on them.
* Apalala lowers its head and breathes over your palms.
* It finds nothing it is looking for. Its jaws close.
